<!-- One pattern per PR. Corrections > additions. -->

**Type:** new pattern / anti-pattern / calibration practice / correction / link fix

**Category file touched:** `categories/….md`

Checklist:

- [ ] Question template is copy-pasteable (real SDK shape, not pseudocode)
- [ ] Atomic judgment only — composition/thresholds/side effects left to code
- [ ] Variable content passed in `state`, question text stays stable
- [ ] Wiring & thresholds section states concrete bands/floors
- [ ] Failure modes section is honest (what actually goes wrong)
- [ ] Every claim has a source link (or "observed in production by the author")
- [ ] `**Added:** YYYY-MM-DD` set to today, ISO format
- [ ] Entry count in README TOC updated if this adds an entry
